topic: Tenses – Present Progressive: Present Progressive (Auxiliaries and verbs)
title: Present Progressive: am / is / are + -ing

explanation.tr:
Present Progressive şu an olan eylemleri anlatır.
• Yapı: am / is / are + fiil-ing
• I am reading. (Okuyorum.)
• He / She / It is eating.
• You / We / They are playing.
Yardımcı fiil (am/is/are) özneye göre seçilir; ana fiile -ing eklenir.
explanation.tk:
Present Progressive häzir bolup geçýän hereketleri aňladýar.
• Gurluşy: am / is / are + işlik-ing
• I am reading. (Men okaýaryn.)
• He / She / It is eating.
• You / We / They are playing.
Kömekçi işlik (am/is/are) eýä görä saýlanýar; esasy işlige -ing goşulýar.
explanation.ru:
Present Progressive описывает действия, происходящие сейчас.
• Схема: am / is / are + глагол-ing
• I am reading. (Я читаю.)
• He / She / It is eating.
• You / We / They are playing.
Вспомогательный глагол (am/is/are) зависит от подлежащего; к смысловому глаголу добавляется -ing.

exercises.question: The cat ___ sleeping on the sofa.

topic: Tenses – Present Progressive: Present Progressive – MIXed Exercise 1
title: Present Progressive: Mixed Practice 1

explanation.tr:
Present Progressive'in olumlu, olumsuz ve soru biçimleri:
• Olumlu: She is reading.
• Olumsuz: She isn't reading. (is not)
• Soru: Is she reading? – Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
• I ile: I'm not ... / Am I ...?
• they/we/you ile: They aren't ... / Are they ...?
explanation.tk:
Present Progressive-iň tassyklaýjy, ýokluk we sorag görnüşleri:
• Tassyklaýjy: She is reading.
• Ýokluk: She isn't reading. (is not)
• Sorag: Is she reading? – Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
• I bilen: I'm not ... / Am I ...?
• they/we/you bilen: They aren't ... / Are they ...?
explanation.ru:
Утвердительная, отрицательная и вопросительная формы Present Progressive:
• Утверждение: She is reading.
• Отрицание: She isn't reading. (is not)
• Вопрос: Is she reading? – Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
• С I: I'm not ... / Am I ...?
• С they/we/you: They aren't ... / Are they ...?

examples.en: Is it raining? – Yes, it is.
He is wearing a blue shirt.

exercises.question: Look! The children ___ in the garden.

topic: Tenses – Present Progressive: Present Progressive – MIXed Exercise 2
title: Present Progressive: Mixed Practice 2

explanation.tr:
Present Progressive ile ilgili her şeyi tekrar edelim:
• am/is/are + fiil-ing
• Yazım: write → writing (e düşer), run → running (ünsüz ikilenir), lie → lying
• Olumsuz: I'm not, he isn't, they aren't
• Soru: Am I...? Is she...? Are we...?
• Wh-soru: What are you doing? Where is he going?
• Sinyal kelimeler: now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!
explanation.tk:
Present Progressive barada ähli zady gaýtalalyň:
• am/is/are + işlik-ing
• Ýazylyşy: write → writing (e düşýär), run → running (çekimsiz iki esse), lie → lying
• Ýokluk: I'm not, he isn't, they aren't
• Sorag: Am I...? Is she...? Are we...?
• Wh-sorag: What are you doing? Where is he going?
• Alamat sözler: now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!
explanation.ru:
Повторим всё о Present Progressive:
• am/is/are + глагол-ing
• Орфография: write → writing (e выпадает), run → running (удвоение), lie → lying
• Отрицание: I'm not, he isn't, they aren't
• Вопрос: Am I...? Is she...? Are we...?
• Специальный вопрос: What are you doing? Where is he going?
• Маркеры: now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!

examples.en: What are you doing? – I'm writing an email.
The boys are swimming in the river.
Right now, we are having lunch.

exercises.question: The boys are ___ in the park.
The man is ___ on the bed.
Choose the correct sentence.
options: He is sit on a chair.
He is sitting on a chair.
He are sitting on a chair.

exercises.question: Find the mistake: "We are swiming in the sea."

topic: Tenses – Present Progressive: Present Progressive – Negations – Long forms
title: Present Progressive: Negatives (Long Forms)

explanation.tr:
Present Progressive'de olumsuz uzun biçim:
• I am not + fiil-ing → I am not sleeping.
• He / She / It is not + fiil-ing → She is not working.
• You / We / They are not + fiil-ing → They are not playing.
Uzun biçim daha resmîdir veya vurgu için kullanılır. 'not' her zaman am/is/are'dan sonra gelir.
explanation.tk:
Present Progressive-de ýokluguň uzyn görnüşi:
• I am not + işlik-ing → I am not sleeping.
• He / She / It is not + işlik-ing → She is not working.
• You / We / They are not + işlik-ing → They are not playing.
Uzyn görnüş has resmi ýa-da nygtamak üçin ulanylýar. 'not' elmydama am/is/are-dan soň gelýär.
explanation.ru:
Полная отрицательная форма Present Progressive:
• I am not + глагол-ing → I am not sleeping.
• He / She / It is not + глагол-ing → She is not working.
• You / We / They are not + глагол-ing → They are not playing.
Полная форма звучит официальнее или используется для акцента. 'not' всегда после am/is/are.

examples.en: I am not sleeping. I am reading.
He is not listening to the teacher.
We are not going to the park today.
examples.ru: Сегодня мы не идём в парк.

exercises.question: Make it negative: "My mum is cooking."
Find the mistake: "He not is sleeping."

topic: Tenses – Present Progressive: Present Progressive – Negations – Short/contracted forms
title: Present Progressive: Negatives (Short Forms)

explanation.tr:
Konuşmada olumsuz cümlelerde kısaltma kullanırız:
• I am not → I'm not
• he is not → he isn't / he's not
• she is not → she isn't / she's not
• it is not → it isn't / it's not
• you/we/they are not → aren't / you're not, we're not, they're not
'amn't' yoktur: I'm not (✓).
explanation.tk:
Gürleşikde ýokluk sözlemlerde gysgaltma ulanýarys:
• I am not → I'm not
• he is not → he isn't / he's not
• she is not → she isn't / she's not
• it is not → it isn't / it's not
• you/we/they are not → aren't / you're not, we're not, they're not
'amn't' ýok: I'm not (✓).
explanation.ru:
В разговоре в отрицаниях используют сокращения:
• I am not → I'm not
• he is not → he isn't / he's not
• she is not → she isn't / she's not
• it is not → it isn't / it's not
• you/we/they are not → aren't / you're not, we're not, they're not
Формы 'amn't' нет: I'm not (✓).

exercises.question: Which short form is correct for "it is not"?

topic: Tenses – Present Progressive: Present Progressive – Sentences – Easy verbs
title: Present Progressive: Sentences with Easy Verbs

explanation.tr:
Kolay fiillerle Present Progressive cümleleri kuralım. Bu fiillere sadece -ing eklenir:
• read → reading, play → playing, eat → eating, drink → drinking, sing → singing, walk → walking, look → looking, cook → cooking
• Cümle: Özne + am/is/are + fiil-ing (+ diğerleri)
  My sister is reading a magazine.
  The boys are playing basketball.
explanation.tk:
Aňsat işlikler bilen Present Progressive sözlemlerini düzeliň. Bu işliklere diňe -ing goşulýar:
• read → reading, play → playing, eat → eating, drink → drinking, sing → singing, walk → walking, look → looking, cook → cooking
• Sözlem: Eýe + am/is/are + işlik-ing (+ beýlekiler)
  My sister is reading a magazine.
  The boys are playing basketball.
explanation.ru:
Составим предложения в Present Progressive с простыми глаголами. К ним просто добавляется -ing:
• read → reading, play → playing, eat → eating, drink → drinking, sing → singing, walk → walking, look → looking, cook → cooking
• Предложение: подлежащее + am/is/are + глагол-ing (+ остальное)
  My sister is reading a magazine.
  The boys are playing basketball.

examples.en: My sister is reading a magazine.
She is looking at the stars.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The man is walk his dog.
The man is walking his dog.
The man are walking his dog.

exercises.question: Find the mistake: "They are play in the park."

topic: Tenses – Present Progressive: Present Progressive – Sentences – Spelling of verbs
title: Present Progressive: Spelling of -ing Forms

explanation.tr:
-ing eklerken yazım kuralları:
1. Çoğu fiil: + ing → read → reading, go → going
2. Sessiz -e ile biten: e düşer → make → making, write → writing, dance → dancing
   (Ama: see → seeing, be → being)
3. Kısa ünlü + tek ünsüz: ünsüz ikilenir → sit → sitting, swim → swimming, get → getting, stop → stopping
4. -ie ile biten: ie → y → lie → lying, die → dying, tie → tying
5. -w, -x, -y ile bitenler ikilenmez: snow → snowing, fix → fixing, play → playing
explanation.tk:
-ing goşulanda ýazylyş düzgünleri:
1. Köp işlikler: + ing → read → reading, go → going
2. Okalmaýan -e bilen gutarýan: e düşýär → make → making, write → writing, dance → dancing
   (Emma: see → seeing, be → being)
3. Gysga çekimli + bir çekimsiz: çekimsiz iki esse ýazylýar → sit → sitting, swim → swimming, get → getting, stop → stopping
4. -ie bilen gutarýan: ie → y → lie → lying, die → dying, tie → tying
5. -w, -x, -y bilen gutarýanlar iki esse ýazylmaýar: snow → snowing, fix → fixing, play → playing
explanation.ru:
Правила написания при добавлении -ing:
1. Большинство глаголов: + ing → read → reading, go → going
2. На немое -e: e выпадает → make → making, write → writing, dance → dancing
   (Но: see → seeing, be → being)
3. Краткая гласная + одна согласная: согласная удваивается → sit → sitting, swim → swimming, get → getting, stop → stopping
4. На -ie: ie → y → lie → lying, die → dying, tie → tying
5. -w, -x, -y не удваиваются: snow → snowing, fix → fixing, play → playing

examples.en: He is sitting next to me.
The old man is lying on the grass.
We are dancing at the wedding.

exercises.question: The bus is ___ at the corner. (stop)
